title.narrative: UNDP IOM 2023-2026: Climate, peace and security in central Mali
UNDP IOM 2023-2026: Klimat, fred och säkerhet i centrala Mali

description.narrative:
Objective
The main objective of this joint project is to improve the peaceful management of natural resources and to better understand and address the challenges of human mobility (forced migration and immobility) in a context of insecurity and climate hazards. This will be achieved by strengthening the inclusiveness of local governance structures and by conducting climate actions with conflict-affected communities in central Mali, particularly with youth and women.
Based on an analysis of available data on climate-related security risks, mapping of ongoing and planned interventions by UNDP, IOM, and other development partners, technical services and in alignment with various planning frameworks a preliminary targeting of intervention zones has been conducted.
The zones of interventions of this project covers six "communes" in the cercles of Douentza and Koro districts located in the Liptako-Gourma zone of central Mali. More specifically, the project will be implemented in the communes of Douentza, Koubel Koundi, and Dianwaly in Douentza and Dougoutènè I, Koporo Pen, and Koro in Koro cercle .

Det gemensamma UNDP-IOM-programmet "Klimatsäkerhet och förvaltning av naturresurser för att skydda mänsklig rörlighet och fredlig samexistens i norra och centrala Mali"
Målet med detta gemensamma projekt är att förbättra den fredliga förvaltningen av naturresurser och att bättre förstå och ta itu med utmaningarna med mänsklig rörlighet (påtvingad migration och orörlighet) i ett sammanhang av osäkerhet och klimatrisker. Detta kommer att uppnås genom att stärka inkluderingen av lokala förvaltningsstrukturer och genom att genomföra klimatåtgärder med konfliktdrabbade samhällen i centrala Mali, särskilt med ungdomar och kvinnor.

The joint UNDP-IOM programme "Climate security and natural resourcees managment to safeguard human mobility and peaceful co-existence in the Northern and Central Mali"

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative: The cooperation agreement to implement the project was signed in May 2023. The project's inception phase was implemented from June to December 2023. During this inception phase, the following activities were realized: an analysis of community mechanisms for the prevention/management of conflicts linked to natural resources was carried out the recommendations of this analysis will be used to set up/reinvigorate these mechanisms, including local NRM agreements for certain shared resources. Identification and prioritization of community assets/peace infrastructures to be rehabilitated/realized through community diagnostics, the use of PDSECs and technical reports from state services. Small-scale equipment (wheelbarrows, shovels, picks, pickaxes, cutters, hammers, crowbars, etc.) has been supplied and will be managed by the management committees and used in the long term to carry out public works in the communities. A mapping of priority actions for disaster risk reduction has begun and will be finalized in 2024.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
